verdict.rationale: Bento documents first-party capture of LLM calls. It captures every span over OpenTelemetry, wraps any LLM or tool call with `bento.track_ai`, captures LLM calls at the SDK level, and records every model call in Google ADK apps. However, the evidence never states which fields a trace contains, so inputs, outputs, latency and token usage are not shown. Only 'cost per run' hints at token accounting. missing for 10: explicit documentation of captured inputs/outputs, latency and token-usage fields per call, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture traces of my LLM calls with inputs, outputs, latency, and token usage

citations.quote: Every span from every framework, captured over OpenTelemetry.
Wrap any LLM or tool call with bento.track_ai.
Bento captures every LLM call at the SDK level.
Capture every model call, tool call, and agent step from a Google ADK app with one line.
you see cost per run, tool failure rates, drift over prompt versions, and regressions across deploys out of the box.
